watches.name: Le Pin Automatic
watches.description: Crafted in Grade 5 titanium and powered by a Swiss Automatic Movement is built to last. – Automatic Watch (Titanium + Swiss movement) – Unique handcrafted pinewood box – Individually numbered & signed Certificate of Authenticity – 2 Year International Warranty – Free Shipping – Shipping Worldwide – contact us for more details if your country isn’t listed Le Pin Automatic Specifications: Case : Titanium Grade 5, natural colour, brushed Case size : 40 mm in diameter, 46 mm lug to lug, 20 mm lug width Height : 10 mm (+2.3 mm double curved sapphire crystal glass) Dial : Ocean Blue sunray brushed dial, with applied index, with a guilloched small second face at 6 o’clock, and a date window at 3 o’clock Bezel : Titanium Grade 5, polished Front Glass : Double curved Sapphire Crystal Glass with anti-reflection coating Case back : Titanium Grade 5 twisted case back, natural colour, polished, engraved serial number, with flat sapphire crystal glass window Crown/Button : Titanium Grade 5 Hands : Hour hand and minute hand with BGW9 lume (blue light), ocean blue watch hand cap, small second hand Strap : Brown Italian Genuine Leather Strap with deep stitching and ocean blue sides Movement : Sellita SW261-1 with at least 38h power reserve and 28.800bhp (4Hz) frequency, with date and small second Water resistance : 50 m (5 ATM)
